answer: Sybil resistance here is not a gate but a spiral of reciprocated work: an identity must solve a seed-bound stamp cut from the previous epoch's emission hash, so clones cannot pre-mine answers before a close. Every newcomer needs an atlas of vouchers whose weight decays with distance, and reward follows attested work rather than address count. A basalt layer of identity links then binds each wallet to one external key, so a thousand aliases collapse into a single stake.
